title: valeriana officinalis subsp. versifolia
intro: Valeriana officinalis subsp. versifolia, commonly known as Western valerian, is a subspecies of the valerian plant, belonging to the Valerianaceae family. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, making it a popular natural remedy for promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Western valerian include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including valerenic acid, valeranone, and valepotriates. These bioactive compounds interact with the GABA receptors in the brain, producing a calming effect and reducing stress levels.
